company.shortDescription: ProcIndex provides AI agents that automate accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliation, and month-end close workflows.
company.description: ProcIndex provides an AI-driven platform that functions as an automated accounting team for finance organizations. The company offers specialized agents that run accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliation, vendor management, and month-end close directly inside existing ERP systems. Its software connects via APIs to platforms such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Sage Intacct, QuickBooks, and other major ERPs, operating in the background while maintaining full audit trails and human-in-the-loop guardrails. ProcIndex’s agents capture invoices from email and portals, perform three-way matching, GL coding, approvals routing, and payment file preparation for payables. For receivables, they handle invoice delivery, payment tracking, collections outreach, dispute handling, and cash application. Additional agents support bank reconciliation, close checklists, and vendor workflows to reduce manual data entry and exception resolution across finance operations.
